issues.summary: A collected stamp is filled with a typed brown (Color(red: 0.54, green: 0.29, blue: 0.16)) instead of colors.actionPrimary, so the stamps ignore dark mode and the Evening variant: they stay daytime cinnamon on the dark card and in the plum palette.

consequences.note: On the menu, the loyalty card is a button whose label holds the stamps: the typed brown is about 2.3:1 on the dark card (it needs 4.5:1), so the audit reports the card on / and Menu in dark mode, in both variants.

issues.summary: A drink's page is padded by a typed 18 points, which isn't on the spacing scale; every other screen uses MotifSpace.s4 at its sides, so this page's edges don't line up with the menu's.
The card's corner is a typed 10 points, which isn't one of the radius roles (the guide gives cards radius.lg, 20), so every card in the app is squarer than the guide says.
The member number is set in .font(.system(size: 15)), a size that isn't one of the text roles, in place of .motifFont(.caption): it doesn't grow with Dynamic Type and drops Readex Pro in Arabic.

Sign in's title hard-codes Georgia over the title role, so it is a different serif from every other heading, fixed in size under Dynamic Type, and in Arabic it drops the theme's Readex Pro for the system's Arabic.

Adding a drink animates the "Added to your order" line with a typed .easeInOut(duration: 0.3) instead of MotifCurves.enter, and no longer through MotifMotion.animation(…, reduceMotion:), so it moves even with Reduce Motion on.
The generated theme code was edited by hand (MotifRadius.md changed from 12 to 14 points), so it no longer matches the design guide, and the next motif tokens will undo it.
Sign in's line under the title is text-secondary faded to 50%, so it's hard to read: about 2.2:1 in light mode and 3.2:1 in dark, in both variants and both languages (it needs 4.5:1).
The loyalty card's Copy button is a plain button as small as its word, 34×17 points where people can tap it beside the member number (28×18 in Arabic); iPhones need 44×44.
A drink's favourite button shows only a heart and has no accessibilityLabel, so VoiceOver says what it looks like ("Love"), not what it does ("Add to favourites").
The cup beside "Your card" grows and shrinks forever, and never asks for Reduce Motion, so it keeps moving for people who turned it on.

Each drink card forces .environment(\.layoutDirection, .leftToRight), so in Arabic the cards don't mirror while the rest of the menu does: the name, description and price sit at the left, under a heading at the right, and the chevron points right, away from the way the screen reads.
Sign out is drawn as the loyalty card's primary action, a full-width cinnamon button, so the least-used and most final thing on the screen is its loudest; it should be the secondary kind.
The menu's sections have no space between their heading and cards or between the cards, so each section reads as one block and the card borders touch.
Add to order, the one main action on a drink's page, is a stock .bordered button (small, tinted, the system's shape) instead of AppButton's full-width primary style, unlike every other main action.
Sign in's button says "Submit", which says nothing about what happens (the guide's voice names the action: "Sign in"), and the string catalogue has no Arabic for it, so it stays English in Arabic.
